name: number_partitioning_k5_n19_seed39264__v2_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 19} into 5 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 38. (The total sum is 19*(19+1)/2 = 190, so the target is 190/5 = 38.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 19 integers in {0, ..., 4} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
